findings.title: Consumer Protection Tuesday: How we leveraged AI to stop a popular Tesla Scam
findings.summary_md: Coinbase's own post says scammers used an AI-generated Elon Musk deepfake to promote a fake Tesla crypto giveaway to a livestream audience of more than 500,000 people. It says hundreds of Coinbase customers tried to send money in about two hours and describes the AI-based effort to stop the scam.

findings.title: Coinbase AI defense blocks $4.7 million from being sent to deepfake Elon Musk scam
findings.summary_md: The Block reported that Coinbase said its AI defense kept $4.7 million from being sent to scammers using a deepfake Elon Musk in a fake Tesla livestream. The report says about 91 percent of attempted transfers linked to the giveaway were blocked.

findings.title: Coinbase AI Stops $4.7M Scam Using Deepfake Elon Musk
findings.summary_md: News.Bitcoin reported that Coinbase's AI fraud detection system prevented $4.7 million in transfers tied to an AI-generated Musk deepfake. It describes attackers hijacking a Tesla flying car livestream watched by more than 500,000 people and promising that crypto sent to a displayed QR code would be doubled. Hundreds of users attempted to wire their own funds within roughly two hours, according to the article.

findings.title: Coinbase AI stops Tesla scam before victims lose millions
findings.summary_md: Cybernews reported that scammers promoted a fake crypto asset giveaway on YouTube during Tesla's flying car demonstration in October. Citing Coinbase, the article says the fake livestream attracted more than 500,000 viewers. The report describes Coinbase's AI system stopping the scam before viewers lost millions.

findings.title: Coinbase AI Blocked $4.7M In Deepfake Musk Scam
findings.summary_md: Bitcoin Magazine reported that Coinbase's AI scam-prevention agent stopped about $4.7 million in customer funds from reaching scammers. The scammers used an Elon Musk deepfake to pitch a fake Tesla crypto giveaway, according to the report.

findings.title: Coinbase Says AI Defenses Blocked $4.7M in Elon Musk Deepfake Crypto Scam
findings.summary_md: Yahoo Finance reported Coinbase's statement that AI-powered fraud detection prevented $4.7 million from reaching scammers. The scammers used an AI-generated video of Elon Musk to promote a fake Tesla cryptocurrency giveaway, the report says.
